thread:
emma (Partnerships): CascadeML reached out — they want quantized forks listed on AWS EU + GCP EU marketplaces, plus a co-sell SI package with NimbleSys. Need to sort licensing, escrow, geo rules, and announcement windows before we sign anything.
lexi (PM): Quick product Q: do they want marketplaces to host downloadable artifacts or to just surface Redwood-hosted endpoints? That affects routing, KV cache, and Dedicated entitlements.
cascade-legal: we prefer marketplaces to be allowed to redistribute downloads under a managed license. Our customers need offline options for edge deployments.
rafael (Legal): red flags: redistribution of artifacts = sublicensing risk. We'll need an explicit NSP (no public swap) + no-sublicense clause and a provenance manifest. Also require export-control warranty and indemnity for sanctioned misuse.
tara (BizDev): commercial asks: CascadeML proposes 76/24 hosted rev-share, marketplaces ask 83/17, NimbleSys wants a 10% integration uplift and a 90-day EMEA-first marketing window. Thoughts?
ben (FinOps): marketplace payouts vary. If we route marketplace -> Redwood -> provider, we need to model VAT, withholding, and potential escrow holds. Escrow adds delay and reconciliation overhead.
ops-bot: infra note: need catalog flags: `marketplace_downloadable`, `marketplace_only`, `entitlement_scope`. Recommend RD-OPS-9811.
lexi (PM): if downloads are allowed, we must prevent Dedicated/Private tenants from pulling marketplace-only downloads unless explicitly entitled. Also need to label variants with `provenance_manifest_url`.
cascade-legal: we'll supply model_hash, quant_profile, training_data_notice, and a signed provenance doc. We can accept a monthly proof-of-use report.
rafael (Legal): okay — require manifest metadata in addendum and monthly POD (proof-of-distribution) reporting. Also legal-bot flagged: Cascade addendum missing geo-block list. Request they specify territories to block.
legal-bot: automated check -> cascade_addendum_v1.pdf missing explicit "geo-block" section. ACTION: ask provider to supply territory list.
tara (BizDev): on rev-splits I'd push marketplace to 82/18 and offer hosted 76/24. NimbleSys uplift at 10% seems fine if it's on top of provider net. For the 90-day EMEA-first ask, marketing-only exclusivity ok if provider funds co-marketing and we limit to marketing/sales outreach — no technical exclusivity.
nimblesys-rep: NimbleSys confirms marketing-only; we want first-look on joint enterprise accounts in EMEA and a co-branded demo page for 90 days.en (FinOps): escrow option: hold marketplace proceeds until compliance attestation (security & export checks) + Redwood verification. Proposed flow: marketplace -> Redwood escrow -> release net to provider 30 days after verification. Need to calculate cashflow impact and fees.
rafael (Legal): escrow is fine but define release triggers and audit rights. Add clause: escrow release contingent on signed compliance attestation and no outstanding sanctions notices. Also include clawback if provenance misreported.
lexi (PM): created RD-OPS-9811 to add flags + `provenance_manifest_url` field and entitlement checks. ETA two weeks for backend + UI changes.
marketing-bot: note: joint PR requirements: draft 14 days prior, asset delivery T-7, embargo aligned with marketplace listing. If provider funds co-marketing, we'll accept 90-day marketing-first window.
tara (BizDev): next steps: (1) I'll push marketplace split to 82/18 and confirm NimbleSys uplift; (2) Rafael will request revised addendum with geo-block list, escrow language, non-sublicense and provenance manifest; (3) Ben to model escrow cashflows + fees; (4) Lexi to track RD-OPS-9811. updates by EOD Fri?
cascade-legal: we'll update addendum with geo-block list and provide provenance manifest stub. We can accept monthly POD and 30-day net after escrow release.en (FinOps): I'll post a sample cashflow sheet showing net vs gross with escrow fees and VAT treatment by region by Wednesday.
emma (Partnerships): Thanks all. Tagging @tara @rafael @ben @lexi @nimblesys-rep — please update this thread with progress. We'll not sign until addendum + RD-OPS changes are in place. :thumbsup:
